title: Sr Product Designer
description:
The Senior Product designer is responsible for building empathy for the Target Guest throughout the product development lifecycle for Target’s web, app and registry product teams and also working enterprise level tools supporting the internal operations through enabling effortless experiences. As a pivotal member the Target India’s UX team, this team member will support Product Designers, Product Managers and Engineering for a broad set of digital and in-store experiences.

* Support product/project teams (product owners, designers, engineering) throughout the project life cycle – recommending appropriate methodology, scoping, and coordinating the entire process, facilitating in-field research and post-research synthesis through analysis.
* Conduct and synthesize qualitative research needed by the projects – including, but not limited to: in person moderated testing, remote moderated & unmoderated testing, surveys, heuristic reviews, benchmark studies, concept testing, online & in-store intercepts, ethnographies, shop-alongs.
* Assist the broader team in keeping our ongoing research library up-to-date and comprehensive.
* Build wireframes and interactive prototypes within the desired timelines of agile sprints
* Enable test and iterate approach for product development.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong Wireframing and prototyping abilities
* Experience practicing UX design research for digital product teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex concepts to cross functional partners
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable speaking to a diverse group of people and leading conversations to discover research insights.
* A strong ability to tell compelling stories from data.
* Comfortable within ambiguity with the ability to prioritize; demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects (both small and large) and adjust to changing priorities
* Strong project management skills – experience managing multiple projects at various stages in the project life cycle.
* Experience running, recruiting, moderating and analysis of online panels and thinking strategically about their application.
* Experience working as part of Agile teams

**About You**

* Four-year degree in Design, Fine Art, or similar area, or equivalent experience
* Minimum 8+ years of experience
* Experience in Lean UX Research methods, including remote moderated & unmoderated testing, online & in-context (store) intercepts.
* Demonstrated understanding of user testing methods & technologies.
* Computer design system skills including Adobe Tools, Sketch, InVision and similar
* Commercial sense, market knowledge, ability to research and apply market/trend information
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to successfully work in a team environment and to respond to business objectives with creative, innovative, and cost-effective design solutions
* Knowledge of product development processes

title: Hub Lead & Senior Facilitator
description:
**A new Nook is coming to Bengaluru, and it will be bigger than any before.**

Project DEFY is a non-profit based in Bangalore. We help communities set up Nooks: self-designed learning spaces where people learn on their own terms, with no fixed curriculum, exams or teachers.

The Bangalore Community Learning Hub opens in February 2027. It brings together sport, self-directed learning, hands-on labs, wellbeing, entrepreneurship and onward pathways in one place, for young people from disadvantaged backgrounds. They move between these at their own pace, and the community helps shape the space.

We're looking for a Hub Lead & Senior Facilitator to build it with us from day one. You'll spend most of your time with learners, families and the community: bringing people together, enabling collective thinking, questioning and care, and helping people turn ideas into action. You'll lead a small, growing team of fellows and lab facilitators by example.

**This is for you if**
you want to work in education but not in a conventional classroom, enable learning without teaching, and solve problems without being patronising. It isn't a job where every instruction is ready for you. The hub's success depends on your own thinking, your willingness to experiment, and your love of engaging people in dialogue.

**What you'll do**

* **Facilitation:**
  co-facilitate in the Nook, lead reflection circles and problem-solving and design sessions, and run collective narrative practice sessions (such as Tree of Life) with learners and families.
* **Community and outreach:**
  build relationships with families, youth groups, local leaders, schools and NGOs; bring young people into the hub; organise community events and showcases; represent the hub locally.
* **Learners' journeys:**
  keep an overview of each learner's path, from sport into the Nook, the labs, the business track and onward pathways, and notice when someone is ready for a next step or drifting away.
* **Wellbeing and safeguarding:**
  be the hub's safeguarding lead, connect young people to the right support, and look after the team's wellbeing.
* **Team and operations:**
  lead the local team day to day, coordinate partner-run parts of the hub, run the site, and manage small budgets within DEFY's procedures.
* **Documentation and learning:**
  collect attendance and learning data, document community stories, and bring what you see on the ground into how the programme grows.

Most of your time is spent with people, not at a desk: about 70% with learners and the community in the first year.

**Essential**

* 2–5 years of hands-on work with communities or young people
* Experience facilitating groups, ideally in non-formal or alternative learning
* Experience coordinating a small team, volunteers or a community group
* Kannada and English, plus comfort working in the languages the community speaks
* Able to be based at the hub in Bangalore, including some evenings and weekends

**Bonus**

* Experience with self-directed learning, design thinking or narrative practice
* Knowledge of child protection and safeguarding
* Living near the community, or a link to it
* Experience of community-building in disadvantaged urban communities

**What you get:**
a founding role in a new model of learning, room to experiment and grow as a leader, training in self-directed learning and collective narrative practice, regular mentoring, and a place in DEFY's global network of Nooks.

**Details:**
Full-time · Bangalore · 12 months, renewable each year · Up to ₹45,000 a month, based on experience · Start as soon as possible, ahead of the February 2027 opening

**Who we especially encourage:**
We strongly encourage applications from individuals from under-represented or marginalised communities, women, persons with disabilities and those who identify themselves as LGBTQI or other identities that continue to struggle to find mainstream acceptance. Besides ensuring opportunities for those with fewer privileges than others, we also truly believe that your experiences in experiencing challenges yourself makes you a strong candidate who may be able to relate with and understand our learning communities who themselves have experienced severe marginalisation. We have found such empathy to be the most important guide as we design and execute programs and new ideas.

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**About the Role**

We are looking for someone to run IT for our India office in Bengaluru. Day to day, that means setting up and looking after laptops, sorting out problems as they come up, managing Microsoft 365 and Intune for the India team, and dealing with local vendors. You will be our main IT person on the ground in India, working closely with the Corporate Technology team in North America, who look after security policy and the more complex Microsoft administration.

We do not have a proper service desk in India yet, and we would like you to set one up. That includes deciding how tickets are categorised, what hours are covered, who is on rotation, and how quickly we respond. If you have done something like this before, even for a small team, we would like to hear about it.

This is a hands-on job. As the team grows there will be room to lead people, but for now you will be doing most of the work yourself, and we are looking for someone who enjoys that.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Laptops and other hardware for our India team, from ordering and setup through to repairs, returns, and keeping the asset register accurate
* Enrolling and managing devices in Intune, including compliance and app deployment
* Day-to-day Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration for India: user accounts, groups, licences, MFA, and access
* Onboarding and offboarding for India staff, so that new joiners are ready on their first day and leavers' access and devices are handled properly
* Support tickets from the India team, and first-line support for colleagues in other regions during your working hours
* The technology in our Bengaluru office: network, Wi-Fi, firewall, printers, and meeting rooms
* Local vendors, warranty claims, and IT purchasing for India
* Setting up and running our service desk, and writing the runbooks the team will rely on
* Keeping devices secure and up to date (encryption, endpoint protection, patching) in line with our security policies, and raising anything suspicious straight away

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 to 8 years in IT operations, where you have been the person responsible for IT at an office or business unit, or have looked after client companies at a managed service provider
* Solid hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, and a working understanding of Microsoft Defender
* Experience managing devices with an MDM. We use Intune, but experience with Jamf or a similar tool is fine
* Comfortable using PowerShell or Microsoft Graph alongside the admin portals. For example, you could pull a list of users or check licence usage with a script
* Good at diagnosing and fixing hardware problems, with a sound grasp of networking basics such as IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN
* You have set up or improved a service desk before, even a small one, and can talk us through what you did
* Clear spoken and written English. You will be working with colleagues in North America every day, as well as junior team members in India
* You like hands-on work. There is room to lead a team as we grow, but this role starts with you doing the work yourself

**Good to Have**

* Basic Linux skills, such as moving around the file system, managing files, and reading logs
* Experience with Fortinet or similar firewalls
* Experience with Freshservice or another service desk tool
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or AZ-104. Any certification on your resume should be current

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

* In your first 30 days: you have picked up India support tickets, got to know how our Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune environment is set up, and checked the India asset register against who actually has which device.
* By 60 days: you are handling onboarding and offboarding for India on your own, with the steps written down, and all India devices are enrolled and compliant in Intune.
* By 90 days: a first version of the India service desk is up and running, with agreed categories, coverage hours, and response times, and the most common fixes are documented.

**How We Will Measure Success**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiners' devices ready on day one, and leavers' devices returned on time
* Accuracy of the asset register
* Device compliance in Intune
* Feedback from the people you support

**Interview Process**

* A screening call with our Talent Acquisition team, which includes a few short technical questions
* A technical conversation with a member of our Corporate Technology team
* A final round in person at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. This includes a practical session in a Microsoft Entra and Azure test environment, and a conversation about hardware and device management

**Why You'll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don't just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.
  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you're leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

Here's what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Work That Matters**
You'll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.

**Career Growth That Matters**
We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.

**Flexibility to Thrive**

**We Celebrate Impact**
From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.

Dymon Asia Capital (“Dymon Asia”), founded in 2008, is a leading alternative investment firm with assets across public and private markets. The Microsoft 365 Engineer builds and operates the firm's Microsoft 365 estate, covering collaboration, endpoint management, identity and compliance for trading, research and corporate teams. Reporting to the Head of Engineering and IT, this hands-on role works mainly in the M365 admin center, Intune, Entra ID and Purview, partnering with the Network, Windows, Linux and Cloud architects and the Cybersecurity Architect to take designs from build to steady-state operation. * Configure and support Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive, including site structures, permissions and data segregation.
* Manage Entra ID, Conditional Access and PIM; run Intune compliance, configuration, app protection and Autopilot across corporate and BYOD devices.

* Operate M365 data backup and run regular restore tests against agreed recovery objectives.
* Deliver tenant-to-tenant and on-prem-to-cloud migrations, move legacy tools to M365, and govern the Microsoft Copilot rollout.
* Act as the M365 escalation point, manage licensing and cost, automate routine work, and ensure alignment with MAS TRM and NIST CSF 2.0, supporting audits and penetration tests.

**Job Requirements**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and related collaboration and endpoint technologies, including configuring and supporting Intune and M365 workloads in production and delivering Microsoft 365 migrations and modernisation projects.
* Experience working in a regulated financial services environment; hedge fund or asset management experience is highly advantageous.
* Strong knowledge of core workloads (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams including voice/telephony, and OneDrive for Business) and Intune/Microsoft Endpoint Manager (compliance policies, configuration profiles, app protection and Windows Autopilot).

* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and Microsoft Graph API for administration and reporting, and Power Automate for workflow.
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102) and Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) required or strongly preferred; SC-300, MS-700 or SC-401 are advantageous. Holders of the legacy Enterprise Administrator Expert credential (MS-100/MS-101/MS-500) will be evaluated on equivalent skills.
* Experience working alongside security, infrastructure and project teams to deliver technical changes, with clear communication skills to explain technical issues to end users and stakeholders.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 configuration, licensing and adoption rollout, exposure to trading, research or market data infrastructure, and familiarity with Azure/Entra hybrid identity and networking concepts are a plus.

**A. Product Management & Techno-Functional Solution Ownership**

* Understand enterprise application architecture, database design, application workflows and system integration mechanisms.

* Understand regulatory gateway integrations and data exchange with external regulatory authorities.
* Work closely with development teams to analyse technical dependencies, investigate application issues and identify root causes.
* Participate in technical solution discussions involving application configurations, data integrity, system performance and integration requirements.
* Have exposure to cloud-based enterprise applications and environments such as AWS or Azure.

**D. Client Relationship & Solution Management**

* Coordinate with technical and migration teams to ensure data accuracy, completeness and integrity.

* Oracle Argus Safety Strongly preferred.
